I gave this a try with both 0.25.0 and latest upstream master. It works fine on both these versions.

What I did was included an incorrect JDBC URL in application.properties:
```
quarkus.datasource.url=jdbc2:postgresql://localhost/hibernate_orm_test
quarkus.datasource.driver=org.postgresql.Driver

quarkus.hibernate-orm.log.sql=false
quarkus.hibernate-orm.database.generation=drop-and-create
```
(notice the datasource.url has an incorrect value `jdbc2:...`)
and in my REST endpoint code, just created a connection:

```
@GET
    @Produces(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN)
    public String hello() {
    	try (final Connection conn = ds.getConnection()) {
    		System.out.println("got connection " + conn);
    	} catch (Exception e) {
    		e.printStackTrace();
    	}
        return "hello2";
    }
```

```
curl localhost:8080/hello
```
